CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_blogs_with_author()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title character varying, slug character varying, excerpt text, content text, featured_image text, author_id uuid, status character varying, published_at timestamp with time zone, meta_title character varying, meta_description character varying, tags text[], view_count integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, author_email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        b.id,
        b.title,
        b.slug,
        b.excerpt,
        b.content,
        b.featured_image,
        b.author_id,
        b.status,
        b.published_at,
        b.meta_title,
        b.meta_description,
        b.tags,
        b.view_count,
        b.created_at,
        b.updated_at,
        u.email::TEXT as author_email
    FROM blogs b
    LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON b.author_id = u.id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, role, hotel_ids)
    VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        NEW.email,
        NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role',
        NEW.raw_user_meta_data->'hotel_ids'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
    SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        role = EXCLUDED.role,
        hotel_ids = EXCLUDED.hotel_ids,
        updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM auth.users
      WHERE auth.users.id = auth.uid()
      AND (
        auth.users.raw_user_meta_data->>'role' = 'super_admin'
        OR auth.users.raw_user_meta_data->>'role' = 'admin'
        OR auth.users.raw_user_meta_data->>'role' = 'hotel_admin'
      )
    )
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: log_payment_event
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_payment_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO payment_audit_log (
        payment_id,
        booking_id,
        event_type,
        event_source,
        payload,
        success
    ) VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        NEW.booking_id,
        TG_OP,
        'database_trigger',
        row_to_json(NEW),
        CASE WHEN NEW.status = 'success' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
    );
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
